Name: Animated Cozy Scarf for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Ffvnd3.png[/img]﻿
[center]Just a simple cozy scarf that flows in the breeze.
I was originally going to have this bundled with some shirts I'm making, but decided to make it a standalone pack.

As always, it's colorable. ^-^




[img]https://i.imgur.com/B92L7co.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿!
Unzip the file and drop the folder, [FS] Luny's Animated Cozy Scarf, into your StardewValley/mods folder.
It'll now appear in the Fashion Sense menu.[/center]

Downloads.Description:
Requires Fashion Sense

Added a second version of the scarf that layers underneath hair.
Scarf should now disappear when swimming.
